meta.data_note: Rebuilt from HKG ERP 041126 FINAL and HKG Finance Tracker 041126 FINAL, anchored 4 Nov 2026. Regions are now districts under one spelling and customer names are consolidated (Halima is one customer). The finance tracker carries one of 11 payment categories on every row and the factory cash book (A/C 2400) runs to 31 Oct 2026, so factory spending for 1–4 Nov is not in the P&L yet. Billet bought from RB Steel (298.84 MT, ৳20.9m, 13–19 Oct) is expensed under Misc in OtherCostInput on the days it arrived.

fac_data.note: A/C 2400 Cash in Hand – Factory. Bank withdrawals and Head Office cash are transfers in, not income. Customer cash already recorded in the main tracker (Bank = Factory) is matched within 3 days and marked so it is never counted twice. The ledger export runs to 31 Oct 2026, so factory spending from 1 Nov onward is not yet in the P&L. Cash sent from head office for factory salaries is a transfer here and appears as wages in this book, not as payroll at head office.
